summary.text: Pete Lynch, a Kentucky Party candidate and faculty member in the University of Kentucky Department of Political Science, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District to Zach Dembo.

paragraphs.text: Lynch is a faculty member of the Department of Political Science at the University of Kentucky, where, according to his Ballotpedia biography, he has studied and taught political science for nearly a decade.
He was on the 2026 general election ballot as the Kentucky Party candidate and said he intended to get most of his donations from small donors.
He campaigned primarily on campaign finance reform, which he called the fundamental problem in American politics.
He received 1.5% of the vote to Zach Dembo's 52.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
